overview: World-class Himalayan trekking website for Shail Hikers with full booking system, Internet Identity login, and Razorpay payments.
features: Internet Identity login with user profile creation
Real-time booking backend with seat availability tracking
Razorpay payment integration with test/production credentials
Protected dashboard showing booking history and status
Trek and yatra detail pages with 12-tab layout
Trek Finder quiz and comparison tool
